finite_water.model: quasi-steady segmented finite-capacity water; no water storage or 3D pipes
finite_water.mapping_model: Fixed 12 physical segments per branch; cell/segment intersection volumes; additive cell K and K*Tin

method.integrator: VTK RK45 bidirectional, merged at shared seed in forward-U order
method.wall_velocity: No-slip wall nodes zero; cell-to-point interior U; cyclic fan points merged
method.wall_check: actual air occupancy at points and quarter chords
method.animation: Steady advection only; independent steady cases, not transient interpolation or AI
